name: The Julius Prague
positioning: Hotel of Rooms, Studios and Suites on Senovážné Square in central Prague, from the House of Julius Meinl
best_for: Travelers who want a suite or studio with a kitchen for a longer Prague stay
Rail arrivals who want to be a short walk from the Main Train Station

facts.text: The Julius is on Senovážné Square in the heart of Prague, moments from the city's historic streets.
Václav Havel Airport is around 30 minutes away by cab.
The Main Train Station is a six-minute walk from the hotel.
The Julius comes from the House of Julius Meinl, a Central European heritage built on craftsmanship and quality.
The Julius Meinl story began in Vienna in 1862, where its founder introduced a new approach to coffee roasting.
The Rooms, Studios and Suites are designed around calm, natural materials and considered detail.
The One-Bedroom Suite has a kitchen and distinct living and sleeping areas.
The Deluxe Studio has a private kitchenette, with living and resting areas that flow into one another.
The Brasserie serves breakfast, lunch and dinner in an Italian-inspired setting, shaped by seasonal ingredients.
The breakfast buffet includes fresh pastries, warm dishes, breads, homemade preserves and seasonal local produce.
The hotel's spaces and services are designed for business or leisure, a single night or an extended stay.

highlights.text: Next door to the hotel, the House of Julius Meinl Gourmet Shop sells fine chocolates, teas, coffees, jams, wines and prosecco.
The Deluxe One-Bedroom Suite with Bathtub is the most spacious One-Bedroom Suite, with a fully equipped kitchen and a generously sized bathtub.
The One-Bedroom Suite with Terrace adds a private terrace to a suite with separate living and sleeping areas and a fully equipped kitchen.
The Deluxe Studio with Terrace has a kitchenette and a private terrace.
The Superior Room has a king-size bed and a walk-in rainforest shower.

considerations.text: Pets are not permitted, except certified service dogs.
Check-in is from 15:00 and check-out is until 11:00.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the historic city centre.
